 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  OR % 22.05.2023 This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 194/2010 dated 10.07.2010 u/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Vasant Vihar.
The parties have been litigating for the last more than 13 years and have decided to put an end to the disputes.

There is settlement dated 20.04.2019 arrived at before the Family Court, East District,
Karkardooma Court, wherein respondent No. 2 has agreed to settle her disputes and cooperate in quashing of the FIR.
There is a child aged 18 years, who is in the care and custody of respondent No.2.

sentences.text: The statement of the petitioner is taken on record.

In addition, the child shall have all his rights in accordance with law against either of the parents as per the judgment of 'Ganesh vs. Sudhirkumar Srivastava' [(2020) 20 SCC 787], The parties state that they have arrived at the settlement out of their own free will, without any threat, pressure, coercion or undue influence.
Respondent No. 2 states that she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
Taking his statement on record, FIR No. 194/2010 dated 10.07.2010 u/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Vasant Vihar, is hereby quashed.
The petition is disposed of.
